subject.title: fix(msteams): strip internal tool-trace banners from outbound text

question: Should this branch become the single Microsoft Teams sanitizer landing candidate once live Teams/Bot Framework proof is attached, or should maintainers instead adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867?
rationale: Both branches implement the same missing hook, neither currently satisfies the external-PR real behavior gate, and automation cannot choose the preferred proof and test package safely.

options.title: Adopt this branch
options.body: Keep this branch's delivery-pipeline regression coverage, require redacted live Teams/Bot Framework proof, and close the older overlap after this branch is viable.

options.title: Adopt the older branch
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95867 if its smaller adapter-focused diff is preferred, but require equivalent real delivery proof before closing this PR.

recommendation.title: Adopt this branch
recommendation.body: Keep this branch's delivery-pipeline regression coverage, require redacted live Teams/Bot Framework proof, and close the older overlap after this branch is viable.
